body: Ran the T1 avian+Tnua headless probe myself under scratch/probe (own target dir inside scratch) instead of leaving it purely to the implementer: test thresholds and the bevy_render tree gate depend on engine behaviour, and argument-from-source already produced one surprise (tnua-avian3d enables avian debug-plugin). Alternative rejected: static source reading only.

Keep criterion (6) literal by vendoring bevy-tnua-avian3d 0.12.1 under vendor/ with a single manifest change (drop avian3d feature "debug-plugin") wired via [patch.crates-io]; stock 0.12.1 enables avian3d/debug-plugin -> bevy/bevy_render in gta_sim. Alternatives rejected: relax the tree gate (contradicts task + bevy-ecs domain), fork the ~450-line integration into gta_sim (more drift), switch controller (GDD binds Tnua).

Expose Tnua jump takeoff_extra_gravity in assets/character/locomotion.ron with start value 10.0 m/s^2: Tnua default 30 overshoots the configured jump_height by +16.5% at 64 Hz (rise 1.165 m for 1.0 m), failing the +-10% gate; 10 gives 1.0625, 0 gives 0.996. Alternative rejected: widen the gate tolerance.

Headless app driven by app.update() without app.finish()+app.cleanup() panics: avian registers ColliderTreeDiagnostics/SpatialQueryDiagnostics in Plugin::finish, so the test harness must call finish/cleanup before the first update.

Physics schedule: keep upstream-tested layout PhysicsPlugins::default() (FixedPostUpdate) + TnuaControllerPlugin/TnuaAvian3dPlugin/drive_characters in FixedUpdate; rejected PLAN_V2 alternative PhysicsPlugins::new(FixedUpdate)+TnuaSystems.before(PhysicsSystems::StepSimulation). FixedMain runs FixedUpdate before FixedPostUpdate every tick, so Tnua->physics order is guaranteed; all 9 bevy-tnua 0.32.0 examples use this layout; probe numbers were measured on it.

BRP screenshot: accept PLAN_V2 plain JSON-RPC call for brp_extras/screenshot (no SSE parser); rejected PLAN.md call_watch_first. Non-+watch HTTP awaits first Some result; screenshot handler returns Ok(None) until capture completes.

Rated the one-tick jump_requested latch losing a tap within jump_buffer before landing as major (fix + gate for the fixer), not critical: probe shows tap lost at 16-94 ms before landing while held input jumps; alternative rejected: leave as owner-run feel, because the loss is intermittent and silent and the plan itself classed it as a gate-worthy defect.

Judged the ledge-assist criterion 'reach governed by named values in locomotion.ron' by an executable sweep (ledge 0.8-2.0 m x run-up x cling_distance 0/0.3/1/2 x jump_height 0.7) instead of accepting FIX_SUMMARY's mechanism text: cling 0.3/1.0/2.0 give identical mantle outcomes (max 1.4 m), jump_height moves it (0.7 -> 1.2 m). Alternative rejected: leave reach entirely to the owner run.

First ledge sweep used a 2 m deep test box; the capsule ran across the top and dropped off the far side within 240 ticks, so every case read as 'fail, y=1.05'. Use a 20 m deep box (or stop the axis) when probing mantle outcomes by final height.

Settled B4 by switching Window.present_mode to AutoNoVsync at runtime over BRP world.mutate_components instead of a probe build with a code change: no production edit, same exe. Result: Fifo 30 FPS on winit's only monitor \.\DISPLAY9 1920x1080@30Hz (primary), AutoNoVsync ~400 FPS (2.2-2.6 ms release). Alternative rejected: temporary PresentMode edit in src/ + rebuild.

First ledge run-up sweep released jump_held on tick%20==19, which for some jump ticks made the jump a 1-tick tap (short hop), so every jump_at=1.2 case read as 'not climbed' regardless of height. Release the jump a fixed number of ticks after the jump tick when probing ledge outcomes.
